bagPolicy.summary: Bags, backpacks or briefcases larger than 5 × 7 inches are prohibited. All bags are searched and guests pass a walk-through metal detector.
allowed: Small personal bag up to 5 × 7 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is shared with the Hollywood resort. The current resort FAQ lists $40 valet parking on Hard Rock Live event nights; check the event for self-parking arrangements.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the Guitar Hotel porte-cochere or Lucky Street valet for rideshare pickup and drop-off.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food is prohibited; the adjoining resort has restaurants and food outlets for guests.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Buy ADA seats at Ticketmaster.com. To exchange tickets you already have for ADA seats, visit the Box Office before show time, though comparable seats aren't guaranteed. Wheelchairs and wheelchair escorts are not provided; resort guests can ask the concierge about wheelchair rentals.

reEntry.summary: All exits are final. There is no re-entry after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.summary: The official Hard Rock Live FAQ explains box office and ticket support; check the event confirmation for pickup rather than assuming tickets can be held at the box office.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: All Hard Rock Live guests pass a walk-through metal detector, with further bag inspections or wand screening when needed. Check each event listing for door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
